title: stryker.com rich-text formatting → EDS authoring (site-wide decision table)
status: Approved 2026-10-27. Implemented in tools/importer/corp-richtext.js (shared by every corp importer). 'established' = behaviour of the news-detail import that produced the migrated news pages (transformers/news-detail-sections.js, #451).

evidence.catalog: tools/importer/data/catalog/typography.json — 1,122 combinations, 4.93M characters of authored rich text (pages + XFs); 56 combinations cover 95%, 227 cover 99%
evidence.conventions: https://main--patients-stryker--aemdemos.aem.live/.da/docs/authoring-guide/authoring-conventions (fetched 2026-10-27): bold / italic / bold+italic / bold+underline links; bold+italic headings and text; underlined heading → bottom border
evidence.measured: https://www.stryker.com/us/en/about.html at 1440px, leaf computed style (2026-10-27). Base text = Humanist 712 14px/400 black; fontsize-<x>em = x × 14px and nested classes multiply (1-25 inside 2-5 = 43.75px); fontsize-8em = 0.8em = 11.2px (small print); urw-egyptienne = Egyptienne for Stryker Light 400; futura-bold = Futura for Stryker 700
evidence.sharesAre: % of all authored rich-text characters; 'text' = p / li / div, 'headings' = h1–h6
evidence.correction: 2026-10-27: an earlier version of this table credited transformers/news-typography.js (#441). That transformer is not used by any importer; the live news pages come from #451, which had no colour tags, no gold rules and h-serif only for Egyptienne h3. Rules below now describe #451 plus the approved additions.

corpStylesAvailable: section styles in styles/styles-corp.css: p-1, p-1-25, p-1-5, p-1-75, serif (+ serif.p-1-25, serif.p-1-5), h-serif, bold-body, label-1-5, join; bracket colours span.color-gold|blue|purple|teal|navy|grey|white; rule-gold

rules.source: text with no class or colour
rules.outcome: as is

rules.source: <b> / <strong>
rules.outcome: markup <strong> (Humanist Bold)

rules.source: span.futura-bold in p / li
rules.outcome: markup <strong><em> (Futura Bold, upright)

rules.source: span.futura-bold in a heading
rules.outcome: unwrap — corp headings are Futura Bold by default

rules.source: h2 / h3 set in span.urw-egyptienne (whole heading, no bold)
rules.outcome: section style h-serif (Egyptienne Light); a Futura h2 / h3 in the same run starts a new section

rules.source: block fully in .fontsize-1-25em
rules.outcome: section style p-1-25 (17.5px) in every template; 'lead' kept as an alias in CSS until the news pages are re-imported

rules.source: block fully in .fontsize-1-5em
rules.outcome: section style p-1-5 (21px)
rules.note: news-detail drops this size today; the style exists in styles-corp.css

rules.source: block fully in .fontsize-1-75em
rules.outcome: section style p-1-75 (24.5px)

rules.source: .fontsize-1em
rules.outcome: drop (= base 14px)

rules.source: .fontsize-2em / .fontsize-2-5em (28px / 35px, mostly Futura + colour: statistics and callouts)
rules.outcome: dynamic numbers (numbercounter / count-up components) -> Statistics block (component table). Static large text in rich text -> plain text with a size section style: NEW p-2 (28px) and p-2-5 (35px), following the p-* scheme; colour and Futura per the other rules.
rules.note: user 2026-10-27: dynamic -> statistics, static -> normal large text

rules.source: .fontsize-8em (0.8em = 11.2px: footnotes, references, legal lines)
rules.outcome: NEW section style p-0-8 (0.8em = 11.2px), added to styles-corp.css next to p-1 … p-1-75

rules.source: span.urw-egyptienne in p / li
rules.outcome: section style serif (combined with the size style: serif.p-1-25, serif.p-1-5)
rules.note: approved 2026-10-27; news pages get it on re-import. serif.p-1-75 and serif.p-0-8 combinations to be added to styles-corp.css

rules.source: h4–h6 set in span.urw-egyptienne
rules.outcome: h-serif has no effect on h4–h6 (corp Futura); kept as Futura

rules.source: span.standalone-link around / inside a link
rules.outcome: markup text (Futura uppercase CTA)
keep as in the source: <i> / <em> -> <em> (italic). Source bold+italic (0.004%) collides with the Futura convention <strong><em>; reported per page, not converted.

rules.source: <sup> / <sub> / <u> in text
rules.outcome: keep <sup>/<sub>; drop <u> on non-links (underline = divider / button convention)

rules.source: a rich text whose blocks use different copy styles
rules.outcome: consecutive blocks with the same copy style share a section; a new style starts a new section (bold-body paragraphs get their own section)

rules.source: nested fontsize classes (sizes multiply)
rules.outcome: use the effective size (product) and map it to the nearest size style (p-0-8 ... p-2-5); sizes beyond p-2-5 -> p-2-5

rules.source: 34 editor / translation-tool classes (tw-*, gr_*, vk_*, mso*, …)
rules.outcome: drop

rules.source: plain <b> label alone on its line ("For investor inquiries:")
rules.outcome: bracket tag [[body-font]…] (bold in the body font)

rules.source: paragraph that is plain <b> as a whole
rules.outcome: section style bold-body

rules.source: span.fontsize-<n>vw / fontsize-<n>-vw (Large Headline lines, hero lines, text)
rules.outcome: bracket tag [[size-<n>vw]…] on the run (innermost vw class): 2 × <n>vw below 600px, <n>vw up to <n> × 14px from 600px (source: 2 × <n>vw below 840px, <n>vw, <n> × 14px from 1439px); lines 1.35 (scripts/corp-type.js, styles-corp.css span.corp-vw)
rules.note: 2026-10-29 lift and shift: replaces the one size per Large Headline band / hero copy; tag names to approve

rules.source: nested span.fontsize-<x>em the section styles cannot carry: mixed sizes in a paragraph, a cell next to other copy, a product of factors off the p-* steps (1.25 × 1.75 = 2.19)
rules.outcome: bracket tag [[size-<n>em]…] with the product: × the 14px base copy in copy, × the heading in a heading; uniform copy on a p-* step keeps the section style
rules.note: 2026-10-29 lift and shift (corp-richtext.js markRuns / finishRuns); tag names to approve

rules.source: span.urw-egyptienne in copy that is not serif throughout (a serif lead line in a cell, serif and Futura in one paragraph), or around a plain <b>
rules.outcome: bracket tag [[serif]…] (styles-corp.css span.serif); copy serif throughout keeps the serif section style

rules.source: a plain <b> (not span.futura-bold) inside a line of copy; a plain <b> in an h1–h3
rules.outcome: copy: [[body-font]…] (bold in the body font), unless the section is bold-body; h1–h3: [[serif]…] (Egyptienne bold, the source heading font). Labels on their own line keep tagPlainBoldLabels, paragraphs bold throughout bold-body

rules.source: Large Headline line copy without a font class
rules.outcome: Egyptienne (the component default, .c-largeheadline .line): [[serif]…] where the section is not serif
rules.note: 2026-10-29 (aaa-2023, promoting-high-quality…). The component's 1vw default size between 840 and 1438px is not carried (14px from 1439px, as the page default)

rules.source: a link in span.futura-bold throughout, alone on its line, no triangle (357 on 112 pages: product names under their image, "CONTACT US" in bands)
rules.outcome: a text link with [[futura-bold]…] inside it (not a button: bold around a whole link is the button convention, and DA moves bold covering a link out of it); its colour as [[color-…]] tags (black included: [[color-black]])
rules.note: 2026-10-29 (nailing-portfolio "Gamma4 Trochanteric Nail": Futura bold 21px black on live); tag names to approve

rules.source: inline colours #edeeec / rgb(237,238,236) (613), #b2b4ae (107), #af6d04 (58), black in a link
rules.outcome: exact bracket tags [[color-light-gray]], [[color-silver]], [[color-dark-gold]], [[color-black]] (styles-corp.css) instead of the nearest shared colour
rules.note: 2026-10-29 (orthopaedic "In my practice…" was rounded to white); tag names to approve

rules.source: span.futura-bold whose text is all in an inner span.urw-egyptienne
rules.outcome: Egyptienne bold, as live (the innermost font class applies): plain bold + [[serif]] (paragraphs and headings), not the Futura bold + italic paragraph form

rules.source: a Large Headline h4 line not set in Egyptienne (24 of 34)
rules.outcome: bold h4 (Futura bold, as live); a plain h4 stays the Columns large-headline light serif title (Block Library rule)

rules.source: curated CTA title (h4.cta-title)
rules.outcome: [[serif]…] (Egyptienne), a linked title also [[color-black]]

rules.source: hero slide / banner lines
rules.outcome: no size-<n> / copy-size-<n> Hero Corp options from the corp engine: each line carries its own [[size-<n>vw]] / [[size-<n>em]] tags; a line without a size keeps the page type (inspace h1 28px)
rules.note: 2026-10-29; the options stay supported for heroes already in DA

colours.rule: exact hex (rgb() normalised to hex) -> bracket colour [[color-<name>]text]. Other colours -> the perceptually closest existing colour (CIELAB dE) among gold, blue, purple, teal, navy, grey, white and default black (= dropped); neutral greys only map to white / grey / default. User 2026-10-27: round to the closest existing colour.

rounded.any other: computed the same way by the transformer

colours.note: new on 2026-10-27: the #451 news import dropped all colours; re-imported news pages gain the colour tags
